name: the-toast-shadow-reads-soft-not-boxed-in-dark
description: the shadow fix has to read the same over a dark page, not only a light one - see the-toast-shadow-reads-soft-not-boxed.json for the full diagnosis. --force-dark-mode rather than system_appearance: the toast shadow switches on the same @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block overlay.css's other tokens do, and courtyard-reads-the-dark-overlay-tokens.json already established --force-dark-mode as the reliable way to flip that media query in this VM.

actions.note: confirms the flag actually flipped the media query this shadow's fix depends on, before trusting anything read after it

actions.expression: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { window.atriumConfirmToast('Link copied', '', true); } return String(document.querySelectorAll('.toasts .toast').length); })()
actions.note: reproduces the reported repro exactly: four stacked Link copied cards

actions.expression: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.toasts .toast'); if (!c) { return 'no card'; } const layers = getComputedStyle(c).boxShadow.split(/,(?![^(]*\))/); return String(layers.length === 1); })()
actions.note: .toast itself must carry only its accent ring, in dark the same as in light
control: toast-surface.js creates this the first time a card's shadow is pushed

actions.expression: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.shadow-probe'); if (!p) { return 'no probe'; } const nums = (getComputedStyle(p).boxShadow.match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?px/g) || []).map(parseFloat); const yOffset = nums[1]; const blur = nums[2]; return String(yOffset <= 6 && blur <= 16); })()
actions.note: --ov-shadow-tight's dark variant is also 5px/14px (only the colour's alpha differs from light), so this must read true here too

actions.expression: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('.toasts'); const c = document.querySelector('.toast'); if (!box || !c) { return 'no card'; } const br = box.getBoundingClientRect(); const cr = c.getBoundingClientRect(); return 'widget=' + Math.round(br.width) + 'x' + Math.round(br.height) + ' card=' + Math.round(cr.width) + 'x' + Math.round(cr.height); })()
actions.note: diagnostic for the report, read before the capture for the same reason as the light sibling
The stack over a dark page, no grey box

assertions.desc: the flag actually flipped prefers-color-scheme, so the run below means something
reproduces the reported repro: four stacked confirmations
The drop shadow moved off .toast entirely, in dark as in light
control: the probe toast-surface.js reads from is there to be measured
The fix reads the same over dark as it does over light
